T_FX_Explosion_6x6.for: Beat 1: the blast at the crashed car that opens the bullet-time window
T_FX_Explosion_6x6.notes: 36 frames. Unlit, masked or translucent. Play once at ~30 fps on a camera-facing quad about 450 cm wide, centred ~150 cm above the car. Pairs with SFX_Explosion.

T_FX_HitFlash_4x4.for: Beats 2-3: a punch landing (player on goon, goon on player, the boss)
T_FX_HitFlash_4x4.notes: 16 frames. Play once at ~40 fps on a camera-facing quad ~120 cm wide at the hit point. Scale 1.6 and tint amber for the combo finisher. Pairs with SFX_PunchHit1/2/3.

T_FX_SpeedLines_4x2.for: The combo finisher (and optionally the Splice blink): a full-screen overlay
T_FX_SpeedLines_4x2.notes: 8 frames of 960x540. A UMG Image stretched full-screen or a post-process blend; cycle at 12-15 fps for 0.25 s. White with some dark wedges; the centre 60% of the screen is clear.

T_FX_FreezeFrame_Overlay.for: Freeze Frame is on: the look of stopped time
T_FX_FreezeFrame_Overlay.notes: 1920x1080, straight alpha, mostly transparent. A full-screen UMG Image shown while FreezeActive; fade in over 0.1 s. Pairs with SFX_FreezeFrameOn.

T_FX_SpliceTrail_2x4.for: Beat 3 onward: the Splice blink, and the moment the boss hands it over
T_FX_SpliceTrail_2x4.notes: 8 frames of 512x128. A quad stretched from the blink start to the blink end (600 cm long, ~90 cm tall), facing the camera, played once at ~24 fps. Pairs with SFX_SpliceBlink.

T_FX_WarnRing.for: The cleaver boss's attack area on the ground (FreezeRing)
T_FX_WarnRing.notes: White on alpha, 10% fill inside. Unlit translucent on a flat plane or decal just above the ground, tinted with the warning colour; rotate it slowly so the dashes move.

T_FX_SceneMarker.for: BP_SceneMarker GiftMesh (five visible spheres on the route)
T_FX_SceneMarker.notes: White with a dark rim. A camera-facing quad ~60 cm, tinted, bobbing; or hide the marker entirely where it only exists for the script.

T_FX_Prompt_4x2.for: Interaction prompt over the crash driver (F) and the coworker (rescue)
T_FX_Prompt_4x2.notes: 8 frames of 256. White disc with a dark inner rim and a closing ring; loop at 8 fps, tint with the power colour, put the key letter on the disc with a TextRender (dark text). Replaces the blue and cyan engine spheres.

T_FX_Telegraph_4x2.for: Enemy attack telegraph (BP_EnemyBase WarnSign, the sphere over each head)
T_FX_Telegraph_4x2.notes: 8 frames of 256. Frames 0-3 pop in, 4-7 hold with a pulse; play once at 20 fps and hold the last frame through the windup. Camera-facing quad ~55 cm above the head. Colour is baked in.

T_Icon_FreezeFrame.notes: 256 px, readable at 64. Pale cyan on a dark tile.

T_Icon_Splice.notes: 256 px. Violet film strip cut on the diagonal.

T_Icon_Rewind.notes: 256 px. Amber double triangle pointing left. Rewind is parked for the demo; the icon is here so the three boxes match if it comes back.
